title: Herdr-lab lesson step gates (hlab-course.v1)
description: Optional per-lesson steps.json: machine-readable step gates that turn SKILL.md s6's step-(b) evidence check from LLM judgment into data. One file per lesson, sibling of exercises.md. Every step the student is gated on gets an entry: what the agent dictates, which command forms count (canonical + valid variants), what output fragment proves non-empty success, whether the command is silent. course-vet.py validates shape and (with --rehearse) that 'recorded' rehearsal evidence files exist and contain the expected fragments; the agent still performs the live hidden-tab rehearsal per SKILL.md s6 - vet is the checkpoint, not the runner.

shell_override.description: Only when a lesson runs under a different shell than the course manifest declares (e.g. a fish-specific step inside a bash course). Absent = inherit course.shell.

steps.description: Steps in gate order; must be a subset of the lesson's exercises.md prose (steps.json never introduces new commands - it formalizes gate evidence for steps already taught).

id.description: Stable step id (alphanumeric-dash), e.g. 's1-raw-qc'. Referenced by quiz task items' task_id.

instruction.description: Text the agent issues as the chat instruction - the same string s6 step 3 dictates, so vet can re-derive s6 behavior from data.

accept.description: Command forms that count as the step being executed (s6 step b 'valid variant' check). Matched as: exact string equal, or the pane buffer line stripped of 'cd X && ' prefixes equal. Case-sensitive. Keep the canonical form first; add only genuinely equivalent variants (flag abbreviations, reordered flags). Do NOT add regexes - this field is for literal command matching, not fuzzy parsing.

output_fragment.description: Any one of these fragments appearing in the pane buffer after the accepted command proves non-empty genuine output. Empty array = the command is expected to be silent (use 'silent': true style instead - for silent commands s6 falls back to the buffer-growth check and does not require a fragment). Mutually exclusive with silent:true.

silent.description: True when the correct execution produces no output (cd, export, mkdir without -p is NOT silent). Vet + s6 then require buffer growth, not a fragment match.

recorded.description: Optional relative path from the lesson dir to a rehearsal transcript holding this step's real output (the s6 hidden-tab rehearsal recipe writes these). When present and it contains output_fragment, vet --rehearse cites file-vs-step instead of agent recall.

note.description: Gate-relevant context the agent must check manually (e.g. 'crash is the EXPECTED outcome for the Raph troubleshooting drill - route to the discussion branch, not the error branch').
